- ID `wp49bp8bqo6c` — “Fedramp Customers have Delayed Purges”, status **identified**, created `2026-11-06T17:47:15Z`, update mới nhất `2026-11-06T17:59:13Z` (“continuing to work on a fix”), component `CDN Cache Purge`.
- Nội dung update investigating: bug trong purge pipeline ảnh hưởng khách hàng FedRAMP, stale content có thể được trả về cho tới khi hết hạn; **“Non-fedramp customers are not impacted.”**
- URL: https://www.cloudflarestatus.com/incidents/wp49bp8bqo6c

- `5tlm9r9j9rpo` — “Cache purge delays in Qingdao Shandong, China”, resolved `2026-10-31T06:57:35Z` (phạm vi địa lý hẹp).
- `8s6pn9rvof3l` — “Cache Purging Delays Affecting Requests Routed Through EEUR”, resolved `2026-10-27T16:14:34Z`; chỉ ảnh hưởng purge-by-URL định tuyến qua hàng đợi EEUR, delay tới 30 phút, kèm ảnh hưởng Always Online. URL: https://www.cloudflarestatus.com/incidents/8s6pn9rvof3l

- Với incident FedRAMP: **không** — nó loại trừ khách hàng non-FedRAMP. Nhưng đây là kết luận về *phạm vi của incident đó*, không phải chứng nhận website của bạn đang hoạt động bình thường.

- Danh sách trên chỉ là các mục khớp trong 50 incident gần nhất; không tìm thấy không chứng minh là không có sự cố. Nếu CLB đang thấy cache không purge, cần kiểm tra trực tiếp (purge by URL vs Purge Everything, khu vực/colo định tuyến, header/cache rules) trước khi quy cho incident này.
- Ngoài ra snapshot có vài incident khác (Chicago, Phoenix-Spectrum, Singapore, Wrangler/Pages/Workers) — không có bằng chứng liên quan đến cache purge hay website của bạn.

The degradation affecting Actions has been mitigated. We are monitoring to ensure stability.
We are investigating reports of degraded availability for Actions

On November 4, 2026, between 15:49 UTC and 16:48 UTC, and again between 17:20 UTC and 17:55 UTC, GitHub Actions, Pages, Webhooks, Code Scanning, and Copilot coding agent experienced delays. During this time, Actions workflow runs and job status updates were delayed by up to 25 minutes. Pages deployments dropped to about 4% of normal volume, webhook deliveries dropped to about 58% of normal volume, and Code Scanning analyses and Copilot coding agent sessions were delayed. Delayed events were processed after mitigation.

This incident was caused by a configuration change to an internal event-routing service that unexpectedly paused delivery of several event streams. The change depended on feature flags that were not set up as intended, which the service did not handle gracefully.
